<b>Courier's Swag</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It can be delivered to settlements across [[Pharloom]].

== Use ==
Courier's Swag  is a fragile item given by [[Couriers Tipp & Pill]] that needs to be transported for the [[Delivery Wishes]] <i>[[Bone Bottom Supplies]]</i>, <i>[[Pilgrim's Rest Supplies]]</i>, <i>[[Songclave Supplies]]</i>, <i>[[Fleatopia Supplies]]</i>, and <i>[[Survivor's Camp Supplies]]</i>. It has 5 hit points, which decrease when [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] takes damage, makes a hard landing, runs into a wall using [[Swift Step]], or hits a ceiling using [[Silk Soar]]. It breaks instantly when using [[Fast Travel (Silksong)|Fast Travel]]  including [[Bellway]]s, the [[Beastling Call]], [[Ventrica]]s or travelling with the [[Flea Caravan]].

== How to Acquire ==
After unlocking Delivery Wishes through Tipp and Pill, Courier's Swag becomes available as one of the delivery options to the various settlements throughout [[Pharloom]]. If the currently held one is destroyed, Hornet can return to Tipp and Pill to obtain another and try again.
